evals.prompt: Design a SaaS dashboard layout with sidebar navigation and data metric cards using Tailwind CSS.
evals.expected_output: The skill reuses existing Tailwind design tokens, applies 8pt spacing grid, ensures WCAG contrast, and defines loading/empty states for metric cards.
expectations: Reuses existing Tailwind design system tokens rather than creating redundant styles
Applies 8pt spatial grid for spacing and layout alignment
Defines loading skeleton and empty state for dashboard metric cards

evals.prompt: Establish a typography system and semantic color token palette for a new web application.
evals.expected_output: The skill defines a type scale, semantic role tokens, and verifies WCAG AA contrast ratio compliance.
expectations: Defines a modular type scale with heading, body, and label hierarchies
Creates semantic color tokens (primary, surface, error, success, warning)
Verifies WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text tokens

evals.prompt: Audit a Button component design for missing interaction states and WCAG focus compliance.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks for hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading states, and validates focus ring contrast.
expectations: Verifies all 8 component states are defined (default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading, empty, error)
Validates focus-visible ring meets 3:1 contrast ratio requirement
